purpose: Review a finite six-concept catalog against the frozen 155-definition and 142-comparator library, select at most one contract-permitted mechanism, and stop before every historical source, candidate, comparator, price or return value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_relative_amount_share_clock_center_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: At each fixed minute divide the stock amount by the same-minute leave-one-out peer mean amount, normalize the 240 positive relative-activity values to unit mass, and take their fixed [0,1] clock center.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: exact 240-bar grid, leave-one-out peer minimum 50, peer mean denominator, unit-mass normalization and x_i=i/239
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It measures migration of a stock's contemporaneous market activity share across the session. Own-amount clock center is invariant to the peer clock, while market-profile synchronization measures shape agreement rather than the clock center of the pointwise own-to-peer ratio. No terminal factor value enters the formula.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_relative_range_share_clock_center_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Replace amount with each bar's high-low range before the same leave-one-out ratio-clock operation.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed range transform and peer benchmark
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Range clock center, range clock variance and market range-profile synchronization already consume this observation. A peer ratio would recombine exposed range-clock and benchmark operators.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_relative_return_variance_share_clock_center_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Use squared within-half returns relative to the same-clock peer mean squared return and summarize their clock center.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed return grid, peer denominator and normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Volatility resolution, return-variance entropy, market shock decoupling and market dispersion already expose return-energy timing relative to peers. The ratio-clock operator is a post-exposure recombination in that family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_cross_sectional_amount_rank_transition_entropy_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Cross-sectionally rank each stock's minute amount and summarize within-stock rank-bin transition entropy.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed rank bins, tie rule and transition normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Amount weak-order entropy and market amount-profile synchronization already consume activity ordering and peer shape, while Campaign150 rejected return-rank mobility entropy. Swapping the state field to amount is an operator refresh.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_relative_transaction_price_activity_clock_center_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Weight the relative amount-share clock by transaction-price displacement from the market transaction-price profile.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed price displacement, sign and joint weighting
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Transaction-price consensus, skew, dispersion resolution and amount-price alignment are terminal. Adding price displacement to the selected raw activity-share state would combine exposed domains and add sign freedom.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_relative_amount_share_late_early_ratio_60m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Compare the average relative amount share in proposed early and late subwindows.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Once the full-grid relative-share clock center is selected, early/late window lengths and ratio normalizations are alternate parameterizations of the same mechanism and are frozen out before values.

selection.reason: The selected factor is the first raw minute mechanism in the complete library whose state is the pointwise own-to-leave-one-out-peer amount ratio and whose statistic is the full-grid clock center of that normalized relative activity mass.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_relative_amount_share_clock_center_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stock whose share of contemporaneous market trading activity migrates toward the close may reflect strengthening late-session attention that can persist from the next open through the third close.
